-- tags/tags.ts --
export const PREMIUM = "premium";
export const BETA = "beta";

-- tags/named.ts --
export { PREMIUM as RENAMED } from "./tags";
-- tags/star.ts --
export * from "./tags";
-- foo/foo.ts --
import { api } from "encore.dev/api";
import { PREMIUM, BETA as BETA_TAG } from "../tags/tags";
import { RENAMED } from "../tags/named";
import { BETA as STARRED } from "../tags/star";

const LOCAL = "local";

export const literal = api({ tags: ["plain"] }, async (): Promise<void> => {});
export const imported = api({ tags: [PREMIUM, BETA_TAG] }, async (): Promise<void> => {});
export const mixed = api({ tags: ["plain", LOCAL, PREMIUM] }, async (): Promise<void> => {});
export const reexported = api({ tags: [RENAMED, STARRED] }, async (): Promise<void> => {});
export const none = api({}, async (): Promise<void> => {});

{

  "dependencies": {
    "encore.dev": "^1.35.0"
  }
}
